create_array_namespace_info: create an array API inspection namespace for PyTorch that exposes capabilities, devices, and dtypes
test_capabilities: test the __array_namespace_info__.capabilities method to return boolean indexing and data-dependent shapes support
test_default_device: test the __array_namespace_info__.default_device method to return the default PyTorch device
test_default_dtypes: test the __array_namespace_info__.default_dtypes method to return real floating, complex floating, integral, and indexing types
test_dtypes: test the __array_namespace_info__.dtypes method to filter PyTorch data types by kind such as bool, integral, or numeric
test_devices: test the __array_namespace_info__.devices method to discover all valid PyTorch device types and indices
